answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn trust only through attested work over time. A new identity starts at dawn with almost no weight, no matter how polished its first output — even a perfect sonnet proves nothing alone. Only after sustained, verified tasks does its badge turn violet and its votes count fully, so an attacker cloning thousands of identities must fund and age every clone, making fake majorities far more expensive than honest participation.
